# Scribe pen trace

`scribe-virtual-pen.bin` is the Task-00 `stylus-virtual-event5.bin` capture
from the first-generation Scribe (Barolo), firmware 5.19.6, on 2026-10-02.
It contains 446 little-endian 16-byte evdev records and five contacts from
`stylus-custom`, including hover, contact movement, and tool departure.
Source and physical/virtual stream relationship: `docs/device/ks1-barolo.md`.
No event node number is used by runtime discovery.
